scenarios.title: User signs in and reaches the dashboard
preconditions: An approved test account can sign in.
The public sign-in page is available.

testData.credentials: Environment variables USER_NAME and PASSWORD; values are not stored in this file.

given: An approved test account can sign in.
The user is on the public sign-in page.
when: The user signs in with the configured valid credentials.
then: The page displays the "Your QA workspace" heading.
expectedResults: Successful sign-in reaches /dashboard with the observed dashboard title and heading.

evidence.detail: Configured credentials were submitted and the dashboard URL, title, and heading were observed.

openQuestions: Which product requirement or acceptance criterion confirms the intended successful sign-in behavior?
Which non-sensitive test account is approved for repeatable test execution?

scenarios.title: Dashboard presents workspace summary categories
preconditions: An approved test account is signed in.
given: An approved test account is signed in.
then: The dashboard presents summaries for "Requirements covered", "Test cases", "Test runs", and "Open defects".
expectedResults: The four observed summary categories are presented without asserting account-specific values.

evidence.detail: The dashboard displayed the four named summary cards.

openQuestions: Which product requirement defines these dashboard summary categories?

scenarios.title: Dashboard presents workspace sections
preconditions: An approved test account is signed in.
given: An approved test account is signed in.
then: The dashboard presents the "Open defects", "Recent runs", and "Weakest coverage" sections.
expectedResults: The three observed dashboard section headings are presented.

evidence.detail: The three named dashboard sections were displayed.
The section headings were observed on the authenticated dashboard.

openQuestions: Which product requirement defines these dashboard sections?

scenarios.title: Dashboard presents project navigation
preconditions: An approved test account is signed in.
given: An approved test account is signed in.
then: The project navigation presents "Dashboard", "Board", "Requirements", "Test cases", "Coverage", "Runs", and "Defects".
expectedResults: All seven observed project navigation entries are presented.

evidence.detail: The seven navigation entries were observed on the dashboard; none of their destinations were exercised.

openQuestions: Should these navigation entries be available for every user role?

scenarios.title: Dashboard presents account and workspace controls
preconditions: An approved test account is signed in.
given: An approved test account is signed in.
then: The dashboard presents "Create", "Go to issue by key", "Toggle light or dark theme", "Sign out", and "Profile" controls.
expectedResults: The five observed account and workspace controls are presented.

evidence.detail: The named controls were observed on the dashboard but were not activated.

openQuestions: What outcomes are expected when each control is used?

coverageGaps: No product requirements or acceptance criteria were supplied for these cases; traceability is to observations rather than confirmed requirements.
Invalid credentials, empty or malformed inputs, validation errors, session expiration, sign-out, and authorization behavior were not observed.
Navigation destinations and controls were not exercised; these drafts assert presence only.
Dashboard metric calculations, persistence, role-specific differences, boundary conditions, and empty-state behavior for a controlled test account remain unverified.
Account-specific metric values and record contents are intentionally not asserted.
